exams.notes: One of two parts of the required examination
exams.quote: The examination shall be conducted in two parts to include a business and law portion and a technical portion.

exams.name: Technical Examination
exams.notes: One of two parts; designed to test technical and practical knowledge concerning analysis of plans and specifications, estimating costs, fundamentals of installation and design, codes, fire hazards, and related subjects. Applicants who fail any part three times may be required to receive additional education or wait one year before retaking.

interval_years.quote: All licenses shall expire on the last day of December in each year following their issuance or renewal.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: All persons, firms, or corporations engaged in the business of either plumbing or heating contracting, or both, shall pay an annual license fee not to exceed one hundred fifty dollars ($150.00).

required.quote: The Board may adopt regulations requiring attendance at programs of continuing education as a condition of license renewal.

available.quote: The Board may, in its discretion, grant to plumbing, heating, or fire sprinkler contractors licensed by other states license of the same or equivalent classification without written examination upon receipt of satisfactory proof that the qualifications of such applicants are substantially equivalent to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in North Carolina and upon payment of the usual license fee.
